regimen_profiles.clinical_summary: PCV combines procarbazine, lomustine and vincristine. In this 42-day regimen it may follow radiotherapy for grade II glioma or be used to help control recurrent high-grade glioma. Ask which setting and treatment aim apply to you.
regimen_profiles.treatment_setting: NCCP 00379: adjuvant treatment of grade II glioma after radiotherapy, or palliative treatment of recurrent high-grade glioma.
regimen_profiles.component_rationale: Lomustine: Lomustine damages genetic material so cells cannot divide normally. It can affect cancer cells and healthy bone-marrow cells. Blood counts may fall several weeks after the single dose, so a day without capsules is not a day without risk. Procarbazine: Procarbazine is converted in the body into substances that interfere with DNA and cell growth. Healthy blood-forming and digestive tissues can also be affected. It has important interactions with some medicines, alcohol and certain foods, so a pharmacy review and written instructions are essential. Vincristine: Vincristine interferes with structures that cells use when dividing. It can also affect nerves controlling sensation, strength and bowel movement. This explains why tingling, weakness and constipation need early review even if blood tests are satisfactory.
regimen_profiles.schedule_context: Lomustine once on Day 1; procarbazine daily on Days 8–21; vincristine into a vein on Days 8 and 29. The cycle lasts 42 days. The number of cycles is individual; treatment continues only while benefit and tolerance support it.
key_points: Lomustine once on Day 1; procarbazine daily on Days 8–21; vincristine into a vein on Days 8 and 29. The cycle lasts 42 days. The number of cycles is individual; treatment continues only while benefit and tolerance support it.

Low counts can be delayed and cumulative after lomustine, so keep any additional blood tests the team arranges. Repeat lung-function assessment during prolonged therapy or when clinically indicated. MRI timing follows the individual glioma plan. Current lomustine product information additionally advises weekly blood counts for at least six weeks after each dose; the team should arrange these alongside the NCCP pre-treatment checks.

administration.cycle_and_sequence: Lomustine once on Day 1; procarbazine daily on Days 8–21; vincristine into a vein on Days 8 and 29. The cycle lasts 56 days. Six cycles are planned, with review before treatment.
route_and_duration: Lomustine is taken once on Day 1 only; procarbazine is taken daily on Days 8–21; vincristine is given into a vein on Days 8 and 29. Follow the pharmacy label for capsule number, food and timing. Do not open or crush capsules. Lomustine is not a daily medicine. Vincristine must only be given intravenously by trained staff.
practical_workflow: Lomustine is taken once on Day 1 only; procarbazine is taken daily on Days 8–21; vincristine is given into a vein on Days 8 and 29. Follow the pharmacy label for capsule number, food and timing. Do not open or crush capsules. Lomustine is not a daily medicine. Vincristine must only be given intravenously by trained staff.
If a capsule dose is missed or vomited, contact the oncology pharmacy for advice. Do not take extra capsules, repeat the single lomustine dose, or extend procarbazine days without instructions.

Bring an up-to-date list of all medicines, including steroids, seizure medicines, anticoagulants, non-prescription treatments, vitamins and herbs. Ask before starting something new. Keep a record of all dose changes.

Avoid alcohol during treatment. Ask for a written food list and medicine interaction check, including the period after procarbazine when precautions still apply. Do not assume an over-the-counter cold remedy, antidepressant, pain medicine or herbal product is safe without pharmacy review.

Keep capsules in their original labelled packs, away from children. Do not open, crush or chew. If swallowing or medicine organisation is difficult, contact the team before the next dose and agree safe help. Return unused chemotherapy to the pharmacy.

Treatment can harm a pregnancy and may affect fertility. Discuss fertility preservation, contraception for patients and partners, and the required period after the final dose before starting. Do not breastfeed during treatment. Ask the team for written, medicine-specific advice.

Ask a trusted person to help check the calendar if memory, vision, fatigue or hand strength makes treatment difficult. Confirm who is responsible for checking doses, collecting medicine, transport and calling for help. Keep consent and personal preferences central.
observation_and_access: Vincristine is intravenous only; confirm safe venous access and extravasation procedures. Oral lomustine/procarbazine need separate calendar and unlicensed supply checks.
